preconditions: the change is ordered by approved ASCII that names the language version it belongs to (design/foundation-closure/FOUNDATION-CLOSURE-TARGET.md section 4: the language-evolution contract)

a change that is not insertion-only is a language version change: the same delta carries the compiler change (S-RUST) that implements it and the evolution qualification records (tests/closure/language-corpus.mjs --check against the frozen table of the previous version, tests/closure/language-manifest.mjs --check --grammar, the new-syntax tests, the unknown-keyword attacks); until that compiler is activated the new text is a PROPOSAL, never authority
invariants: LANGUAGE VERSION BOUND: after the station closes, the version ASCII-GRAMMAR.md declares (a line 'LANGUAGE VERSION <n>') equals the version the parser implements (tests/closure/language-manifest.mjs --grammar); a text that describes a language no activated compiler implements is refused

INSERTION-ONLY unless the delta is a language version change: every annotation block begins with a line starting '<delta> ANNOTATION' and no existing line is deleted or modified (git diff --numstat reports 0 deleted lines)
NEW SYNTAX NEVER AUTHORIZES ITSELF: a language N+1 statement is documented as a proposal until Compiler N+1 is activated by the Factory; the corpus of language N stays the compatibility oracle
FACTORY-LAW.md is never changed by this station
verification: per-file deleted-line count 0 against the canonical base (insertion-only mode) or the evolution qualification records present (version-change mode)
